passages.note: Bill restricts advertising/marketing of firearms to minors; it does not address ownership bans, weapon-type bans, background checks, or carry-permit rules, which are the clauses separating the rungs.

rows.reasoning: The only source is AB 2571, which Bauer-Kahan authored, prohibiting firearm marketing that is 'designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.' None of the rungs address advertising or marketing of firearms; the ladder differs on ownership bans, weapon-type restrictions, background checks, and carry rules, none of which this bill's operative text touches. This is adjacent, not on-question, so no chair is established.
